scope: bounded localisation-PROBE ablation pilot on the existing 24 P3 pilot proteins
label: exploratory P3 tuning pilot; NOT an evaluation and NOT a held-out result

population.sequences: ORIGINAL, UNMASKED sequences; no masking token is introduced anywhere

sae.validated: reference agreement 0.000e+00, active counts exactly k=128 (intervention_validation)

edit.mechanism: validated DIRECT decoder-delta, unchanged from intervention_pilot/run_pilot.py
edit.formula: delta_h = ((topK(a_edited) - topK(a)) @ w_dec) * std ;  h' = h + delta_h
edit.hook: forward hook on esm.encoder.layer[7], whose output IS hidden_states[8]
edit.applied_at: one residue position at a time; no other position is touched

positions.indexing: one-based residue positions, as previously specified

conditions.name: no_op
conditions.desc: hook registered, latent 1446 set to its OWN current value; delta must be exactly zero

conditions.name: ablate_1446
conditions.desc: latent 1446 set to 0 at the position

conditions.name: random_direction_matched
conditions.desc: a seeded random unit direction in R^1280 scaled to the L2 norm of the ablation's delta_h, added at the same position only

random_control.draw: standard normal in R^1280, normalised to unit L2, scaled to ||delta_h_ablation||
random_control.seed_rule: deterministic per (accession, position): SHA-256 of 'ACC:pos' truncated to 64 bits
random_control.note: feature 1446 still has NO eligible activation-matched SAE control; this is a direction control, not an activation-matched feature control

inactive_policy: if latent 1446 is exactly 0 at the position, the ablation is a ZERO edit; the matched random control then also has norm 0 and is a ZERO edit. The case is retained and counted, never dropped and never relocated.

readout.probe: frozen layer-26 ESM-only localisation probe from layer_sweep/v1/probe_parameters.npz
readout.features: concat(mean over all visible residue tokens, mean over first min(30,L) residue tokens) of hidden_states[26]
readout.pooling_rules: residue tokens only; <cls>, <eos> and padding excluded - unchanged from the sweep
readout.primary: change in the probe's EXTRACELLULAR LOG-ODDS, edited minus clean
readout.aggregation: average the three position-level changes within each protein, THEN take the paired candidate-minus-control difference across proteins

verification.clean_vs_saved: clean log-odds must reproduce the saved P3 predictions (layer_sweep/v1/p3_predictions.npz, esm_L26) within the tolerance below
verification.tolerance_rationale: the saved predictions came from batched extraction with float16 compute and float16 pooled storage; this pilot runs single-sequence float32 forwards, so exact equality is not expected. Any exceedance is reported, not suppressed.
verification.no_op_vs_clean: the no-op must reproduce the clean run; required delta_h L2 exactly 0.0 and log-odds difference below 1e-6

descriptive: how often latent 1446 was active at each position
forbidden: editing at any layer other than 8
interpretation_limits: A change in our own probe's score is a MANIPULATION CHECK, not evidence about encoding (spec section 1.3, readout A).
24 proteins at 3 positions is a pilot; no interval here is a confirmatory result.
The random control tests direction at matched magnitude. It is NOT an activation-matched SAE feature control, and none exists for 1446.
Nothing here can establish that a protein's biological location changed (spec section 1.4).
